scripts.dev: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const ip = execSync('node localIP.js').toString().trim(); require('fs').writeFileSync('.env.local', `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_HOST=${ip}`); execSync(`cross-env HOST=${ip} next dev -H ${ip} -p 3000`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.start: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const ip = execSync('node localIP.js').toString().trim(); require('fs').writeFileSync('.env.local', `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_HOST=${ip}`); execSync(`cross-env HOST=${ip} next start -H ${ip} -p 3000`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"
